Hi Luke — thanks for the heads up and for sending the VAT proof.

Short answer: we likely applied VAT because the billing flow in our system treated MVNA as a direct customer for platform usage rather than as an agent/marketplace operator. That causes invoices to be issued with VAT by default. We need to confirm the commercial role (agent vs principal) and whether the supplied VAT number should trigger reverse-charge in our billing engine.

Next steps from our side:
- Finance will validate the VAT number against the UK VIES/MTD registry (I can do that now).
- If confirmed as a valid GB VAT and the place of supply indicates customer accounting, we will raise credit notes for the affected invoices and reissue self-billed invoices indicating the reverse-charge (0% VAT, reference to Article/Regulation).
- We need a short written confirmation that MVNA is acting as agent/marketplace for these transactions (or alternatively identify which merchant(s) are principals). That affects whether we can zero-rate or need to reassign invoices.

I've attached our self-billing template and a draft credit-note template for internal use. If you can confirm the agent vs principal status (or provide a list of merchant VAT numbers) we can triage the reissue.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
